Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
These document out outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be 
 performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
Technical Specification:
Supplier | : 
 Peerless Pump USA
Type | : 
 Vertical Centrifugal Pump (7 Stage)
Power | : 5 
 HP
Speed | : 
 2900 rpm
Capacity | : 25 
 GPM
Discharge pressure | : 10 Kg/cm2
The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata, tested by 
 eng. Ali Abd Elslam, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by general 
 director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head 
 sector of Talkha Power Station.
This document accepted by 
 eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: 
 EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC planning & financial 
 prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head 
 sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area
 is required.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used: safety helmet, 
 safety shoes ... etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker or the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pumps must be completely drained.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, manual puller.
Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Rags.
Work to be Carried Out
Pump in Operation
Checks discharge quantity and pressure and record them.
Checks the vibration level of the pump set complete with the motor then, 
 record them.
Pump Out of Operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value and record it.
Make test for bearings oil and added or change it (if it is needed).
Check flanges for water leakage.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tighten (if it is needed).
Check glands for water leakage and re-paint (if it is needed).
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint (if it is needed).
